title: Interequinoctial

inlines.v: INTEREQUINOC'TIAL, adjective [inter and equinox.] Coming between the vernal and autumnal equinoxes. Spring and autumn I have denominated equinoctial periods. Summer and winter I have called interequinoctial intervals.
